note: What a server sends to change one thing about a spell already in a unit's slot. The kind settles what follows it. The header names the unit this is about.

bits.name: summonerSpell
bits.note: Set where the slot is a summoner slot rather than one of the unit's own.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Purpose undetermined; a server sends these bits clear.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: Which thing about the spell is being changed, and so which shape follows. What follows a kind other than the one that sets a name is undetermined.

fields.name: name
fields.note: The name the client loads the spell under. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.
